description: Add meaningful tests to tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py (and, where the behavior lives there, tests/test_evaluate_rag.py) covering the five required categories, and harden scripts/farmer_evaluation.py ONLY where a test exposes a real gap in the required guarantees. The type is 'test' conceptually but recorded as 'feat' in task.json enum terms if needed; the primary deliverable is meaningful tests that would fail if the guarantee were reverted.
steps: Missing evidence: add tests proving that an empty/blank scorecard, an empty claim ledger, and an empty participant-task ledger all fail (assess/assess_claims/assess_tasks return False), and that a claim row missing required evidence fields (source, page, excerpt, reviewer) fails. Assert these map to a fail-closed outcome.

Duplicate identifiers: add tests proving assess() rejects duplicate case ids, assess_claims() rejects duplicate (case_id, claim_id) pairs, and assess_tasks() rejects duplicate (participant_code, task_id) pairs. Each must return False with a message indicating duplicates.

Denominator calculations: add tests asserting the exact denominators — claim grounding uses number of claim rows (e.g. 9/10 => 90%), and pilot success + comprehension use participant x task observations (e.g. 40/40 across 8 participants x 5 tasks). Assert the summary strings report the denominator the plan requires (claims for grounding; participant/task observations for pilot).

Threshold boundaries: add exact-boundary tests. Claim grounding: exactly 90% passes, just-below-90% fails (choose counts that hit the boundary exactly, e.g. 9/10 pass vs 89/100 fail or 8/9 fail). Pilot completion and comprehension: exactly 80% passes, just-below-80% fails, and verify BOTH metrics are gated (one at 80% and the other below 80% must fail).

Fail-closed release decisions: add tests proving a mandatory/critical safety scenario failing forces failure even when averages are high, and that any missing-evidence condition yields the fail-closed (REPORTE) result. If the scaffold generator from FEAT-003 exists at test time, also assert it emits REPORTEE when ledgers are missing/blank; otherwise assert farmer_evaluation fail-closed behavior.

Only if a test reveals farmer_evaluation.py does NOT actually enforce a required guarantee (exact threshold, duplicate rejection, denominator, or fail-closed), make the minimal code fix in scripts/farmer_evaluation.py to satisfy it. Do NOT change thresholds away from the plan's values (>=90% grounding, >=80% success, >=80% comprehension). Preserve French user-facing wording and existing safety refusals. Do NOT touch core/fertilizer.py, core/source_policy.py, static/data/fertilizer.json, Data/reviews/*.
Keep all existing tests green. Re-run the K2 suites and the full offline suite.
acceptance_criteria: Tests exist for all five categories: missing evidence, duplicate identifiers, denominator calculations, threshold boundaries, fail-closed release decisions
Each new test exercises real code in scripts/farmer_evaluation.py (or scripts/evaluate_rag.py) and would fail if the corresponding guarantee were reverted
Claim grounding is verified to use claims as the denominator and require >= 90%
Pilot success and comprehension are verified to use participant x task observations and each require >= 80%
Missing evidence is verified to produce the fail-closed (REPORTE/REPORTEE) outcome
All three verification pytest commands and pnpm test:js pass
findings: Added 15 meaningful tests to tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py (file went from 6 tests to 21) covering all five required categories; NO production code change was needed because the FEAT-001 audit confirmed scripts/farmer_evaluation.py already enforces every required guarantee. Reusable helpers added: _write_rows, _claim_row/_claim_rows (build N claim rows with a chosen supported count against real benchmark case agronomy_01/development), _task_row/_task_rows (build 8x5=40 participant/task rows with chosen completed/understood counts). Tests by category: (1) MISSING EVIDENCE: test_empty_ledgers_and_scorecard_fail_closed (blank scorecard + empty claim ledger + empty task ledger all return False); test_claim_row_missing_evidence_fields_fails (blanking each of source/page/excerpt/reviewer -> 'Incomplete claim evidence'); test_task_row_missing_evidence_fields_fails (blank observer -> 'Incomplete participant task evidence'). (2) DUPLICATE IDENTIFIERS: test_scorecard_rejects_duplicate_case_ids ('Incomplete or duplicate case identifiers.'); test_claim_ledger_rejects_duplicate_case_claim_pairs ('Duplicate claim identifiers.'); test_task_ledger_rejects_duplicate_participant_task_pairs ('Duplicate participant/task identifiers.'). (3) DENOMINATORS: test_claim_grounding_denominator_is_claim_row_count (9/10 => '9/10','(90%)','substantive claims reviewed'); test_pilot_denominator_is_participant_times_task_observations (40/40 => 'participant/task observations across 8 participants'). (4) THRESHOLD BOUNDARIES: test_claim_grounding_exact_ninety_percent_passes (9/10 pass); test_claim_grounding_just_below_ninety_percent_fails (8/9=88.9% fail); test_pilot_metrics_exact_eighty_percent_passes (32/40=80% pass, '(80%)'); test_pilot_completion_just_below_eighty_percent_fails (31/40 fail); test_pilot_comprehension_gate_is_independent_of_completion (completion 32/40=80% but comprehension 31/40 -> fail, proving BOTH gates apply). (5) FAIL-CLOSED: test_critical_claim_case_high_average_still_fails_when_safety_fails (all-yes scorecard but one critical safety_pass=no -> 'A mandatory safety scenario failed.'); test_missing_evidence_never_yields_release_pass (no evidence => no ledger can pass). Plan thresholds untouched (>=90% grounding, >=80% success, >=80% comprehension); French wording and safety refusals preserved. No changes to core/fertilizer.py, core/source_policy.py, static/data/fertilizer.json, Data/reviews/*; NUMERIC_GUIDANCE_VERIFIED left False; no live evaluation. EXACT TEST TOTALS: (1) `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py tests/test_evidence_ledger.py tests/test_evaluate_rag.py` => 40 passed (test_farmer_evaluation.py alone = 21 passed). (2) `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests --ignore=tests/test_rag.py` => 694 passed, 1 skipped, 1 warning (PyPDF2 DeprecationWarning). (3) `pnpm test:js` => 33 pass, 0 fail. (4) `git diff --check` => clean. Baselines were 25 / 679 / 33; deltas +15 / +15 / +0 as expected. Files changed: tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py, SESSION.md (dated K2 FEAT-002 entry appended).
